messages.text: Hi Sarah

The Thor P2 is $369, 10 TH/s, 166 W — about $12 a month in power at 10¢/kWh. It's a real draw at a full block every ten minutes, and you keep the machine.

What do you pay per kWh?
My question is about shipping
Happy to help — what's the question? Where it's shipping to, or when it ships?
So I bought a few months ago the DC06 from you guys and was going tho get the P2 but your site now says you don't ship to Saudi Arabia anymore

That looks right — our plug variants currently check out to Europe, UK, AU, NZ, Singapore, Malaysia and the UAE, and Saudi isn't on that list. I don't want to guess at an exception, so I've put it to Georges.
Handed to the team · Checkout no longer accepts Saudi Arabia; shopper wants to know if we can still s

The team picks it up today at 10am ET and the answer comes to your email.

In the meantime — is the DC06 you bought already up and running, or is it still on the way?
It's up and running and it's working great

Good to hear. Worth knowing the P2 is a different animal: SHA-256, so it mines Bitcoin, not the DOGE/LTC your DC06 runs. That's a second coin on your shelf, not more of the same.

Is that what you were after, or were you adding more scrypt?
Probably both if we can get this shipping thing solved

Noted — I've added the second unit to what Georges picks up, so he can sort shipping and both units in one go.

On the scrypt side you've got the DC06 again or the Nexus L1 at $399.99. If you liked the DC06, matching it is the simple answer.
I don't want to buy on Alu Express

Understood — you'd be buying from us, not a marketplace. Same store you got the DC06 from, same support, and we sort the plug for your address.

The only open thing is whether we can get it to Saudi. Georges has that today at 10am ET and the answer comes to your email.
You did before so I hope we can do it again

That you've already had one delivered there is the strongest thing in your favour, and I've put that in the note for Georges.

One thing that'll help him: what email is on your DC06 order? He'll reply to that one.
(email hidden)
Handed to the team · Saudi Arabia no longer available at checkout; returning customer wants to buy tw

Got it — that's on the note with your earlier order, so Georges can see the Saudi delivery went through fine.

He picks it up today at 10am ET and the answer comes to that email.
Is the difference in hasrate between the DC06 and DC08 wortht the price difference?
Searched the catalog · Hammer DC08 scrypt miner
Read the hammer miner scrypt dc06 330 mh s page

Close call, slightly in the DC08's favour. DC06 is $379.99 for 330 MH/s at 105 W; DC08 is $539 for 480 MH/s at 137 W — about 45% more hashrate for 42% more money, and a bit less power per MH.

So: same value per MH, fewer boxes and plugs with the DC08.
what do you mean fewer boxes and plugs?

If you want ~480 MH/s out of DC06s you need two of them — two power supplies, two outlets, two things on the shelf, and $760. One DC08 gets you there in one unit on one socket.

If 330 MH/s is enough, the DC06 is the cheaper way in.
Let's get the shipping cleared up and then I'll decide on the DC06 or 08
Used the chat-interview skill

Sounds good — Georges has it today at 10am ET and the answer lands in your email.

Before you go, one thing: what made you want a second scrypt miner rather than moving over to Bitcoin with the P2?
I already have 2 Qaxes and want to improve my Doge

That changes the picture — with two Qaxes already on Bitcoin, the DC08 is the one that actually moves your Doge number.

What's the Doge side about for you, the block shot or steadily stacking?
in this case it's the block shot, I have an L9 stacking

Then it's purely tickets per second, and the DC08's 480 MH/s is 45% more draws than another DC06 for $159 more. That's the one.

I'll leave it there — Georges has the Saudi question today at 10am ET and replies to your email. Good luck on the block.
cool, thanks for the help, I'll be on the look out for George's email
Thanks Pedro — enjoy the rest of your day, and I hope the Saudi route works out so you can get the P2 and the DC08 running.
thanks
Any time. Take care.
